publisher: New York State Board of Elections
title: Ballot Billboard (election newsletter) with the county vote, General Election, November 6, 1984, New York State

offices.president: President (votes for the highest elector, one column per party line)
offices.house: U.S. Representative in Congress, one block per congressional district; rows are the parts of counties (Part of Suffolk) with a TOTAL row when the district spans several counties, and one column per candidate and party line

hint: Leaves 3-5 are one president table split by columns (same county rows on each leaf). Leaf 6 (turnout) and 7-8 (ballot proposals) are skipped. Leaves 9-13 hold the 34 congressional districts; the state senate blocks start on leaf 14. Copy TOTAL ENTIRE STATE as printed_total.
